learning_outcomes.text: Understand the theoretical foundations and methods for the design and execution of joining connections.
Acquire specialized knowledge about the application of processes according to requirements.
Compare and select the processes based on task-specific boundary conditions.
Weigh the advantages and limitations of the different joining processes.
Analyze and solve technical problems in the field of joining technology.
Work independently in the field of welding technology.
Collaborate effectively in interdisciplinary teams and coordinate team tasks.
Develop solutions for problems in welding technology considering sustainability aspects.

syllabus_topics: Classic welding technology (fusion and pressure welding)
Modern joining technology (electron beam welding, laser beam material processing)
Brazing, metal bonding, thermal cutting (oxy-fuel, plasma, and water jet cutting)
Introduction to new topics and critical questioning
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the written exam. Successful participation in the practical course is a prerequisite for taking the exam.
